gaps.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.
gaps.note: Nondegeneracy of a subspace with respect to an indefinite bilinear form (so that U and U^perp are complementary and the projection exists) is not covered by undergraduate linear algebra and is not explained or linked.

gaps.term: label growth along a side wire
gaps.quote: a label containing $t_T$ may grow to $t_S^\perp$
gaps.note: Labels are subspaces of F=(Q^h)^{⊗3}, but t_T lies in Q^h, so 'a label containing t_T' and 'grow to t_S^perp' (dimension h-1, gain h-2) only make sense factor-wise in one tensor slot; the page never says this, nor which wire or tensor factor is meant.

gaps.quote: Each of the $3\binom h3^2$ invocations has $h$ central wires
gaps.note: An invocation is never defined; why there are 3*C(h,3)^2 of them (a coordinate and the two other triples fixed?) and why each has h central wires is not shown.

gaps.term: loss of h per decreasing edge
gaps.quote: each losing $h$ on a decreasing edge
gaps.note: The page never says which edges decrease or why the loss is h; the only label change it gives is a gain of h-2, so h is unexplained and not obviously consistent with it. L and hence the bound s<WD rest on this.
The count assumes exactly W sinks (one per role) with N of them of dimension D-1; the page never states that the number of sinks is W, so WD-N for sinks cannot be checked.

gaps.quote: The paper's decisive property is a bound on the number of smaller calls, (cited).
